title: CmdHistory
description: CmdHistory is a simple moderation plugin that lets staff view a player’s recent commands. Use /cmdhistory <player> to open a GUI with signs showing the commands they executed, which can also help catch admin abusers.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87d55c1501ebee93af56524e4615c90acf99dde3.png)
`CmdHistory` is a simple moderation plugin that lets staff view a player’s recent commands. Use `/cmdhistory <player>` to open a GUI with signs showing the commands they executed, which can also help catch admin abusers. It supports multiple pages and starts logging commands as soon as the plugin is installed and the server is started.

Permissions:

* `cmdhistory.use` *(OP default)* — Allows use of `/cmdhistory`
* `cmdhistory.bypass` — Exempts players from being tracked
